candidates.title: The Windmill That Stopped
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the community windmill stopped turning while the grain mill waited for flour before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they oiled the axle, but the sails still shuddered without completing a turn; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a bird's abandoned nesting twine had wound tightly around the brake lever; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they unwound the twine, checked the brake, and restarted the mill for the bakers, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Sign That Pointed Backward
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a freshly painted direction sign sent festival visitors toward a closed road before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they turned the sign around, but visitors arriving from the other side became confused; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the painter had copied the arrows from a reflection in a shop window; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they repainted the arrows from a verified map and guided everyone to the fair, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Seed That Would Not Sink
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a rare tree seed floated away from the nursery during a spring flood before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they tried to catch it with a net, but the current carried it beneath a narrow bridge; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a line of fallen leaves showed a quiet backwater where floating objects gathered; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the stranded travelers watching, they waited beside the backwater, retrieved the seed, and planted it above the flood line, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
